policy: minutes is the single theatrical runtime printed in the English Wikipedia infobox, which is kept for the original theatrical release. Retrieved 2026-11-08. citedSource is included only when that infobox cites a film classification board. A title is omitted from totals when the infobox gives more than one runtime, or when the title is a series, game or book whose runtime is not verified episode by episode.
